serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: NCR VOYIX Government Cloud is a GCP native API–first cloud driven environment, which hosts and manages NCR’s Various Commerce Solutions such as, Advanced Marketing Solution (AMS), Freshop applications and BSL Open API services. These Offerings provide Government Agencies with Commerce Point-of-Sale Systems (such as Emerald, Aloha, RPOS, non-NCR POS, etc.) and Applications to facilitate both in-store and above-store grocery, gas, loyalty, and/or food ordering transactions. Additionally, BSL Open APIs, provide common interfaces for customers and 3rd parties to more easily enable their applications and services within the customer’s ecosystem.
